description: This file defines a React component 'FileComponent' used to render and manage a file preview within a web application's rich text editor. It handles loading the file, observing its visibility, and controls zoom level adjustments for image display.

classes.name: FileComponentProps
classes.description: TypeScript type defining props for the FileComponent, including class names, format, node key, file UUID, zoom level, and setter.

methods.name: FileComponent
methods.description: React functional component that renders a file preview, manages loading based on visibility, and offers zoom control.

methods.name: setImageZoomLevel
methods.description: Callback to update the zoom level for the image, updating the editor state and parent state.
